title.zh: 卷八十四 志第三十七 律曆十七
title.raw: 卷八十四 志第三十七 律曆十七 Volume 84 Treatises 37: Measures and Calendar 17

sentences.zh: 演紀上元甲子歲距，紹熙五年甲寅歲積三千八百三十。

translations.literal: In the era-cycle calculation, from the Superior Origin in the year jiazi to the distance in years to the fifth year of Shaoxi, jiayin, the accumulated year-count is three thousand eight hundred thirty.
translations.idiomatic: By the era-cycle reckoning from the Superior Origin in the year jiazi, the elapsed count to the fifth year of Shaoxi (1194), year jiayin, stands at 3,830 years.

sentences.zh: 至慶元已未歲積三千八百三十五開禧上元甲子至開禧三年丁卯，歲積七百八十四萬八千一百八十三，成天上元甲子距鹹淳七年辛未，歲積七千一百七十五萬八千一百四十七。

translations.literal: By the jìwèi year of Qingyuan the accumulated year-count is three thousand eight hundred thirty-five; from the Superior Origin jiazi of Kaixi to the third year of Kaixi, dīngmǎo, the accumulated year-count is seven million eight hundred forty-eight thousand one hundred eighty-three; from the Superior Origin jiazi of Chengtian to the distance in years to the seventh year of Xianchun, xīnwèi, the accumulated year-count is seventy-one million seven hundred fifty-eight thousand one hundred forty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: By the jiwei year of Qingyuan (1199) the accumulated count reaches 3,835 years; from the Kaixi Superior Origin in the year jiazi to the third year of Kaixi (1207), year dingmao, the accumulated count is 7,848,183 years; from the Chengtian Superior Origin in the year jiazi to the seventh year of Xianchun (1271), year xinwei, the accumulated count is 71,758,147 years.
